headings.rules: Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Use this for all headings to avoid the generic Inter look.

colors.rules: No full-screen gradients. Use Primary Purple (#6C3BFF) for main CTAs and Accent Green (#22C55E) for success/delivery status. Text on primary elements MUST be white for APCA/WCAG contrast compliance.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-gray-100. Apply to sticky headers, bottom navigation, and modal overlays. NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-gray-100 to ground cards and neumorphic elements.

consumer_app.structure: Sticky top bar (location + search). Horizontal scroll snap categories (snap-x snap-mandatory). Fixed bottom navigation.
consumer_app.spacing: p-4 or p-6. Generous vertical spacing between sections (gap-8).

merchant_dashboard.structure: Sidebar navigation. Top bar for user profile. Main content uses grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Single-metric focus on KPIs.
merchant_dashboard.spacing: p-8. Cards use p-6 internal padding.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase on cards. Color darkening on buttons (hover:brightness-95).
motion.page_transition: Framer motion fade and slight slide-up.
motion.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Disable transforms on universal transitions.

components.cards: Flat background, soft 16-20px radius, 1px subtle border, soft shadow.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary CTAs (Apple style). Heavy font weight (font-semibold).
components.inputs: Shadcn based. rounded-xl, subtle border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#6C3BFF]/20 focus:border-[#6C3BFF].
components.navigation: Bottom nav for consumer (mobile), Sidebar for Admin. Always include a visible navigation bar.
components.charts: Shadcn charts or Recharts. Use primary and accent colors.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. White text on primary purple.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all focusable elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a JS environment. Make sure all Shadcn components and logic use .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx.
Prioritize mobile-first layouts for the Consumer Portal and high-density, job-based layouts for the Merchant Dashboard.
Use SF Pro Display (or system sans-serif fallback) for headings with tight tracking, and Inter for body text.
Implement glassmorphism using 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70' on sticky headers and bottom navs. Never use completely transparent backgrounds over scrollable content.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements.
Avoid standard Tailwind card styling; use the defined soft shadows and 16-20px border radii.
For the dashboard, mimic Stripe's 'Single-Metric Focus' by giving the primary KPI (e.g., Gross Volume/Revenue) the largest visual weight.
For the Consumer app, mimic Blinkit/Zepto by placing the 'Add to Cart' button within immediate thumb reach and keeping the checkout flow to a single screen.
Avoid applying 'transition: all' in CSS; explicitly specify properties to prevent breaking transforms.
Do not center-align the main app container; text should naturally flow from the left.
Do not use generic emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
In the Merchant Dashboard, use Shadcn tables and layout elements strictly but inject the design system's spacing and border-radius rules.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic by applying the custom shadow, spacing, and border-radius tokens defined here.
Dark colors look good independently; DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than standard).
Use sonner for toasts. Note that sonner components are located in .js files (e.g., /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js).
Do not use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Use Shadcn components and customize them.
Ensure all mock data looks realistic, and use the provided image URLs instead of placeholders.
